tests.name: 4942/2141在场攻击及固定减半，百分比与真实伤害不减，免伤仍独立
tests.assertion: test('4942/2141在场攻击及固定减半，百分比与真实伤害不减，免伤仍独立',()=>{for(const type of['attack','fixed','percent','true']){const values=[];for(const soul of[false,true]){const s=make({move:10200,index:-1,soul});observe((e,c)=>{if(type!=='attack'&&e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1)c.hurt(c.t,1000,'减伤类型测试',type);},()=>turn(s,10200,type==='attack'?10127:20309));values.push(sum(s,type,1));}assert.ok(Math.abs(values[1]-values[0]*(['attack','fixed'].includes(type)?.5:1))<=1);}});

tests.name: 4942/2141回合初无强化攻击增伤50%且忽略自身负级，等级原值不修改
tests.assertion: test('4942/2141回合初无强化攻击增伤50%且忽略自身负级，等级原值不修改',()=>{const values=[];for(const atk of[0,-2,-6]){const s=make({move:10200,index:-1,soul:true});s.fighters[0].stages.atk=atk;turn(s,10200,20309);values.push(sum(s));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stages.atk,atk);}assert.equal(new Set(values).size,1);const p=make({move:10200,index:-1});turn(p,10200,20309);assert.ok(values[0]>=sum(p)*1.48&&values[0]<=sum(p)*1.52);});

tests.name: 4942/2141回合初有强化获得3回冰呪并视正为负，真实正级保持，回合内强化变化不重选分支
tests.assertion: test('4942/2141回合初有强化获得3回冰呪并视正为负，真实正级保持，回合内强化变化不重选分支',()=>{const s=make({move:10200,index:-1,soul:true});s.fighters[1].stages.def=2;turn(s,10200,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].stages.def,2);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].effects['冰呪'].end,3);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.ice2141.boosted,true);const p=make({move:10200,index:-1});p.fighters[1].stages.def=-2;timer(p,0,'冰呪');turn(p,10200,20309);assert.equal(sum(s),sum(p));const q=make({move:10200,index:-1,soul:true,aStats:{spe:10}});turn(q,10200,20117);assert.equal(q.fighters[1].stages.atk,1);assert.equal(q.fighters[0].soulState.ice2141.boosted,false);assert.equal(q.fighters[0].effects['冰呪'],undefined);});

tests.name: 4942/2141真实死亡清回合冰封，免异独立；下一只条件歧义只记录不替代当前分支
tests.assertion: test('4942/2141真实死亡清回合冰封，免异独立；下一只条件歧义只记录不替代当前分支',()=>{for(const had of[false,true])for(const immune of[false,true]){const s=make({move:10200,index:-1,soul:true,hp:1,aStats:{spe:1,def:1},bStats:{atk:9999}});s.fighters[1].effects=had?{攻击必中:{start:1,end:99}}:{};if(immune)s.fighters[1].counts.immune=1;turn(s,10200,10127);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,0);assert.equal(Object.keys(s.fighters[1].effects).length,0);assert.equal(!!s.fighters[1].ailments['冰封'],!immune);const e=s.fighters[0].soulState.iceInheritance2141;assert.equal(e.requiresActualNextAlly,true);assert.equal(e.pendingCondition,had?'Q-4942-002':undefined);assert.equal(e.conditionConfirmed,!had?true:undefined);}});

tests.assertion: test('4942/1960击败保护清强吸强而非反转，2105/2532/2280明确真实队伍延期且未伪造当前伤害',()=>{const s=make({...row(1960),targetHp:1});s.fighters[0].stages.atk=1;turn(s,s.auditMoveId,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].hp,0);assert.ok(s.fighters[0].effects['雷纳多强化防消吸']);const p=make(row(2532));turn(p,p.auditMoveId,20309);assert.equal(sum(p,'true'),0);assert.equal(p.fighters[0].soulState.benchDrainRequest2532.move,29444);assert.equal(p.fighters[0].soulState.benchDrainRequest2532.requiresRealBenchDamageAndRecipients,true);const q=make(row(2280));timer(q,0,'skillBlock');turn(q,q.auditMoveId,20309);assert.equal(q.fighters[1].soulState.noVoluntarySwitch2280.start,2);assert.equal(q.fighters[1].soulState.noVoluntarySwitch2280.requiresRealSwitch,true);const r=make(row(2105));turn(r,r.auditMoveId,20309);assert.equal(r.fighters[1].hp,9000);});
